If you’ve seen Blind Fury, I’d love to hear what you remember about it.Tim Matheson29.7K views · March 16 at 4:48 PM0:41The magic of #VirginRiver is the community. It’s a town where people slow down a little, find love, find their way again, and show up for each other when it matters most. Season 7 drops tomorrow on Netflix, so I hope you’re all caught up and ready! And it’s always a treat to stop by KTLA 5 Community. I grew up watching this station, so getting to sit with them and talk about what’s ahead is a real full-circle moment.Tim Matheson73.9K views · March 11 at 9:32 PM1:47Well folks, we are back in action!! Season 7 of Virgin River premieres on March 12th and I hope you're ready to enjoy the ride!Tim Matheson220.7K views · February 90:33This Groundhog Day, I'm heading to Chicago to celebrate comedy, community, and one very special friend. On February 2nd at 3pm, join us in celebrating the 3rd Annual Harold Ramis Day with a "Groundhog Day" meets "National Lampoon’s Animal House" crossover at Harry Caray’s Navy Pier! There'll be fellow "Animal House" cast members, Chicago Harry the Groundhog, and a live ceremony honoring comedy legend Harold Ramis -a brilliant talent and a wonderful human being who gave us all so much laughter. Ritual meets rebellion for a Groundhog Day you won’t want to miss! Hope to see you there!
